triage.summary: The checkout service is experiencing a high error rate of 25%, with errors related to payment failures (invalid token). The payment service is suspected as it is involved in the payment processing and has a related failure runbook. The error traces show checkout failing to charge cards due to invalid tokens.

hypotheses.rationale: The payment service is causing errors in the checkout service due to invalid payment tokens, supported by error traces and logs.
The checkout service itself is showing high error rates, possibly due to handling payment failures.

diagnosis.summary: The primary fault is in the payment service causing checkout errors due to invalid tokens. Checkout errors are secondary effects.

internal.title: Incident Resolved: Checkout Service Errors Due to Payment Failures
internal.body:
At 10:32 UTC, an alert was triggered for high error rates in the checkout service. Diagnosis identified the root cause as payment failures caused by invalid payment tokens in the payment service. The issue was confirmed by logs, error traces, and metrics. The paymentFailure flag was disabled at 10:51 UTC, leading to verified recovery of the payment service error rate. The incident is now resolved.

Timeline:
- 10:32: Alert received for checkout service errors.
- 10:51: Diagnosis confirmed payment service failures.
- 10:51: Disabled paymentFailure flag.
- 10:51: Recovery verified with error rates returning to normal.

Next steps include a detailed postmortem and lessons learned to prevent recurrence.

external.title: Some checkouts failed due to payment processing issues
external.body: Between 10:32 and 10:52 UTC, some customers experienced issues completing checkout due to payment processing errors. The issue was identified and resolved promptly, and normal service has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

output.summary: High error rates in the checkout service were caused by payment failures due to invalid payment tokens in the payment service. Disabling the paymentFailure flag resolved the issue and restored normal service.
output.impact: Customers experienced failures completing checkout during the incident window, impacting transaction success rates.
output.root_cause: The root cause was payment failures in the payment service caused by invalid payment tokens, which propagated errors to the checkout service.
output.resolution: The paymentFailure flag was disabled, which stopped the propagation of errors and allowed the services to recover. Recovery was verified by monitoring error rates returning to normal.

lessons.lesson: Implement more robust validation and handling of payment tokens to prevent invalid tokens causing service errors.
lessons.applies_when: When payment service error rates spike due to payment token issues and the paymentFailure flag is active.

lessons.lesson: Improve error handling in checkout service to gracefully manage upstream payment failures without causing high error rates.
lessons.applies_when: When checkout service error rates increase in correlation with payment service failures.

action_items: Review and enhance payment token validation logic in the payment service.
Improve error handling and fallback mechanisms in the checkout service for payment failures.
Establish monitoring alerts specifically for payment token validation errors.
